title: Initialization Boundary Contract
description: Which parts of this repository are Factory Core, which are the Reference Sample, and which are the initialization surface a new product must rewrite. `stage` is declared and then cross-checked: a tree that renames its package may not keep calling itself the baseline.

stage.description: `baseline` = the Factory itself (Reference Sample allowed, baseline identity must be intact). `product` = an initialized tree (no baseline or sample identity on the initialization surface).

baselineIdentity.description: What the uninitialized baseline looks like. Product stage requires all of these to be gone.

sampleOwned.description: Path prefixes owned by the Reference Sample. Identity is legal inside these; they are excluded from the scan and counted in the report.

productFacing.description: The initialization surface: files a new product must check, rewrite or delete. Every one of them must exist.

sampleMarkers.description: Strings that identify the Reference Sample's own product identity. Forbidden on the initialization surface in product stage.
